notes: This draft manifest is not yet promoted into the primary phase06_ui_sample_manifest.json.
Its purpose is to freeze and validate the next regular-source candidate chain after the current P0/P1/P2/P3/P4/P5 supply reached 20/20 live passed and the regular file workset was exhausted again.

The current public cangjiechallenge scout only leaves three credible regular-lane candidates from already approved pinned repos: AIAtom SpeakPage, AIAtom entry index, and the SecureMeet app-shell index page. HanziPage remains deferred because its page contract drives HanziWriterCanvas through direct animate/reset bridge calls more heavily than the already-accepted PrototypePage and is therefore a worse first regular draft candidate.
